name: team_planning_set_position
description: Open a position in a scenario of a Team Planning plan, or change or reopen one by passing its position_id. A position is a framework role and one of that role's levels (the level pay bands key on), in a unit, at an FTE above 0 and at most 1. basis 'backfill' is committed budget; 'new' is planned. Give every field each time: the scenario's position becomes exactly this. Steps after the scenario, and its alternatives, inherit it unless they change it. Refused unless the caller is one of the plan's editors.

scenario_id.description: The scenario, or the plan's id for the baseline.

position_id.description: Omit to open a new position.
